name: Brax, The Furnace-Born
status_values: not_started | in_progress | done | stand_in | pending_human | blocked

0_concept_reference.notes: The front is approved by the user. The side, 3/4, back, expression, gauntlet and colour-script sheets have ready-to-paste prompts and wait for a human to generate and approve them. The palette and colour callouts are measurements of the approved front, not new design.

front.notes: The user supplied it as the approved front concept (1536x1024, T-pose, flat navy background). references/brax_concept_front.png is a byte-identical copy that the stage-1 track uses as TRELLIS input.

side.notes: Prompt ready. Generate it in ChatGPT with the front attached, check it against the acceptance list, and save it as references/BRAX_side_approved.png.

back.notes: Prompt ready. It includes a proposed back design (cracks over the shoulder blades, no second sigil) that the approver confirms or changes first.

expression.notes: Prompt ready: 6 heads. Used for portraits, the codex and close-ups; the face is 1-2 px in gameplay.

weapon_gauntlet.notes: Prompt ready: 8 orthographic views including the closed fist, which stage 3 needs for rigging the finger plates.

color_script.notes: Prompt ready: flat, approved, game light, Heat 0, Heat max and Meltdown states. The measured palette item below stands in for this sheet's colour values until it is approved.

palette.notes: Automated measurement of the approved front (13 swatches, shadow/base/highlight). The values are exact for the front plate, so engineering can use them for shader and UI colours now. This is a STAND-IN for the painted colour-script sheet, which it does not replace: it has no lighting states and no Heat or Meltdown looks.

brief.notes: Built from the content rows, the approved front and measurements. The design proposals in section 7 are decided by the approver through the pending sheets.

readability_check.notes: 2D approximation: the front plate at 65/86 px, on the biome grounds and pasted into a client frame. Findings are in brief.md section 5. The real check through the 55-degree camera belongs to stage 1.

1_blockout.notes: Owned by the parallel stage-1 track (tools/comfy/run_trellis.py). TRELLIS.2 seeds s101, s202 and s303 were in source/ (local, gitignored, listed in manifest.json) by 14:55 on 2026-09-25, with review sheets in reports/blockout/. That track sets this entry when it picks a seed. SCULPT REFERENCE ONLY: never shipped, never copied to assets/models/.

2_production_mesh.notes: Human artist in Blender 5.2: manual retopo (~15-25k tris), clean shoulder/elbow/knee loops, UVs, hand-painted NPR textures (palette.json values, brief.md sections 4 and 6). Any automated retopo or decimation made so engineering can proceed is a stand_in.

3_rig.notes: The GF_Hero_v1 master skeleton does not exist yet (docs/ART_PIPELINE.md describes the plan). Auto-rig plus hand weight-paint fixes; a human signs off the weight painting (shoulders, hands, face).

4_animation.notes: The shared clip set on GF_Hero_v1 plus Brax's unique set (proposal in brief.md section 8). Mixamo/ActorCore seeds are prototyping stand-ins only.

5_export_validate.notes: Headless Blender CI writes assets/models/characters/brax.glb, uncompressed because bevy_gltf 0.20 supports no Draco, meshopt or quantisation. A human applies the final Hades-II bar.

human_gates.gate: stage 0: approve the side, 3/4, back, expression, gauntlet and colour-script sheets
